prompt: I'm reviewing my Contracts MBE practice. I missed several questions about when to apply the UCC versus common law. How do I keep this straight?
expected: Load mbe.md. Explain UCC Article 2 for sale of goods vs common law for services/real estate; mixed contracts use predominant purpose test. Offer targeted drill follow-up.
actual: I've loaded the MBE strategies guide. For Contracts, UCC vs common law is a frequent trap: UCC Article 2 covers sale of goods (moveable tangible property); common law covers services and real estate.
